name: Mizkan Hon-Mirin Pure Sweet Rice Cooking Wine
whyItWorks: Naturally fermented sweet rice seasoning that glazes proteins and eliminates gamey notes. Alcohol cooks off completely during simmering, leaving a soothing natural sweetness without refined syrups.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer equal parts tamari, water, and mirin with a slice of fresh ginger to create a gentle homemade teriyaki glaze for salmon or chicken.
